# Wizard
[color=#457573][italic]IT'S WIZARD TIME MOTHERF-...[italic][/color]
Wizards are forces of chaos and unpredictability. You never know what they will do next. They are usually sent by the [color=#40E0D0]Space Wizard Federation[/color], although one might instead be someone whom a group of enthusiasts turned into a wizard after rolling a critical success on a cursed die. And because wizards are so unpredictable, one may appear when you least expect it!
## Grimoire
[bold]By wizard law, the grimoire is bound to you.[/bold] This means you cannot share it. Its spells and equipment are for you alone. The grimoire is used to obtain a wide variety of spells, items, and creatures. Everything available to you is [italic]extremely powerful,[/italic] so you only have 10 [color=#FF0000]W[/color][color=#FFA500]i[/color][color=#FFFF00]z[/color][color=#00FF00]?[/color][color=#0000FF]o[/color][color=#4B0082]i[/color][color=#8F00FF]n[/color]T to spend. The only limitation besides the price is your imagination. Try different combinations!
If you need time to ponder, the [bold]Pondering Orb[/bold] lets a wizard connect to the station's cameras and spy without being seen. This can be useful when you are planning something or want to stay one step ahead of [color=red]Security[/color].
